selectedOriginals.caption: This picture shows the front of the light house in Atlantic City, NJ. The light house is 282 feet tall and is hard to see because of the many large hotels. The lighthouse is the second tallest in the state.
selectedOriginals.inspection: Full original inspected: cream painted tapering circular masonry shaft with broad near-black central band, sparse narrow sashes, broad corbelled gold/pale gallery and vertical/cross lantern framing. Reconstructed two-storey keeper house has red standing-seam hipped roof, central small dormer, white chimney, brackets under eaves, five upper front sashes and open wraparound lower porch with paired columns/white balustrade and central stair. Caption282ft/second-tallest is incorrect against operator171ft/tallestNJ; do not use caption dimensions.

selectedOriginals.caption: 2007 NJ Lighthouse Challenge
selectedOriginals.inspection: Full original inspected: night side view corroborates cream-black-cream tower bands, sparse staggered sashes, large corbelled open gallery, glazed lantern, red hipped house roof, cornice brackets, central dormer and white chimney. Warm night floodlighting does not establish material daytime color.

additionalInspected.caption: This is an image of a place or building that is listed on the National Register of Historic Places in the United States of America. Its reference number is 71000492 (Wikidata).
additionalInspected.inspection: Full4000x6000 original inspected: exposed round brick-painted base, at least four staggered shaft sashes across white/black regions, broad slightly flared upper neck, projecting triangular gallery corbels and pale/gold vertical rail, polygonal glazed lantern. Tower is behind and separate from main keeper-house mass, linked by low small gabled entrance. Nearby modern housing/fence/lamps excluded.

additionalInspected.caption: Absecon Light in Atlantic County, New Jersey.  On the NRHP since 1971.
additionalInspected.inspection: Full3268x4053 local HABS NJ-734 sheet3/4, JohnD.Milner1964, actually inspected. Upper B/C sectionD-D shows first-order Fresnel lens, low cylindrical watchroom/inner stair, broad projecting gallery, tall polygonal lantern with rectangular vertical mullions/two horizontal pane lines, shallow pyramidal roof and tall ventilator. Graphic six-foot scale is present; no dimensions digitized yet. Historic upper assembly must be compared with current photos; this sheet does not measure reconstructed keeper-house plan.

additionalInspected.caption: Absecon Lighthouse in Atlantic City, New Jersey, USA, April 2008
additionalInspected.inspection: Full distant elevated original inspected: actual current cream-black-cream bands, broad lower white shaft and black middle zone, upper pale neck and corbelled gallery, gridded polygonal lantern.
